(II)--creation is of three kinds in primitive times --at will, at mere sight and at a simple touch. But after दक्ष's epoch creation by sexual union came into being;
1: Br.
(III)--a son of Dhruva; asked his own shadow to become a woman, and this was छाया, mother of five sons, प्राचीनगर्भ and others. Br. II. ३६. ९६-8.
